title: Hammer Mace
description: The mace texture is now changed to look like a hammer. The breeze rods are brown to match the handle of the Hammer Mace
body: This texture pack changes the mace texture to look like a hammer. The breeze rods are also brown with this texture pack to match the hammer mace's handle. After applying this texture pack, maces will look like a hammer so the (player) was smashed by (player) death message makes more sense. For me at least.
